name: Knock Rummy
summary: A rummy-style melding game where a player can knock to end a hand and force a low-unmatched-points showdown.
rules_text: Deal 10 cards each for 2 players, 7 for 3-4 players, 6 for 5-6 players. Place remainder as stock, flip top as upcard discard pile. On turn draw the upcard or stock top, then you may knock before discarding to end the hand. Discard one. After knock, knocker lays melds (3-4 of a kind or 3+ sequence same suit) and announces unmatched count (face =10, ace=1, others pip value, though variations exist). Others do same. Lowest unmatched wins difference from each opponent. Knocker going rummy (zero unmatched) gets +25 bonus per opponent. If knocker ties, tying player wins. If knocker is not lowest, knocker pays 10 penalty plus difference to the lowest player. If stock empties, next player may take discard top or flip discard without shuffling to new stock.
rating_reason: Rummy variant turn-based hidden hands strategic melding knocking.
